records.command:
$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'
$semanticProtocol = Get-Content docs/benchmarks/2026-10-08-semantic-protocol.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$semanticCandidates = @('lexical') + @($semanticProtocol.models | ForEach-Object { $_.id })
foreach ($semanticCandidate in $semanticCandidates) {
  $semanticSlug = $semanticCandidate.Replace('/','--')
  & .dip-local/laya-env/Scripts/python.exe scripts/semantic-alternatives.py --protocol docs/benchmarks/2026-10-08-semantic-protocol.json --model $semanticCandidate --output ".dip-local/semantic-$semanticSlug.json" --cache .dip-local/semantic-cache
  Write-Output "ATTEMPT_EXIT $semanticCandidate $LASTEXITCODE"
}
